arguments.command:
id; cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
# example case
X = np.array([[1614,1414],[1814,1314]])
y = np.array([0,1])
clf = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')
clf.fit(X,y)
t = clf.tree_
print('nodes', t.node_count)
for i in range(t.node_count):
    print(i, t.feature[i], t.threshold[i], t.children_left[i], t.children_right[i], t.value[i])
print('classes', clf.classes_)
# single class
X2 = np.array([[1,2],[3,4]])
y2 = np.array([0,0])
clf2 = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')
clf2.fit(X2,y2)
t2 = clf2.tree_
print('single-class nodes', t2.node_count, t2.value[0], clf2.classes_)
# three-class with tie values
X3 = np.array([[1],[1],[2],[2]])
y3 = np.array([0,1,2,3])
clf3 = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')
clf3.fit(X3,y3)
t3 = clf3.tree_
for i in range(t3.node_count):
    print(i, t3.feature[i], t3.threshold[i], t3.children_left[i], t3.value[i])
print(clf3.classes_)
EOF
